law_name: Law No. 1/87 of 29 July 1987 on Copyright and Neighbouring Rights; the Bangui Agreement (revised 1999), Annex VII, also applies as Gabon is an OAPI member
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Law No. 1/87 of 29 July 1987 on copyright and neighbouring rights); photographs, anonymous, audiovisual, posthumous and applied-art works: publication + 50 years
notes: Gabon appears as WCT party from 6 Mar 2002 (WIPO document) and WPPT in force 20 May 2002 (Dutch treaty database). Berne/TRIPS not checked.
